planner_notes: CareDx is a COMMERCIAL-STAGE diagnostic biotech with $333.8M revenue (2024), GAAP net income $52.5M, $261M cash, no debt. This profile is NOT a typical AIRO-signature short candidate: the 'stock for services' + 'material weakness' phrases triggered the mechanical screen, but the material weakness is an ICFR/COSO process deficiency tied to stock-based comp accounting (immaterial corrected errors), not revenue recognition or going-concern. Revenue is heavily Medicare-dependent (38% of total, 50% of testing services) and concentrated in AlloSure Kidney's Palmetto/MolDX LCD coverage — the real adjudicable risks are payer-coverage durability, FDA clearance status, clinical evidence depth, and IP litigation (Natera) — not federal-customer inflation or capacity overclaim. Most-substantive pre-cutoff filing is the FY2024 10-K (filed 2025-02-28).
